inspection.scope: One mirrored empty pair, separately connected authored boot assemblies. Closed sole and cream material shell with inner lining/well, fixed sage cuff/ribs, overlays, tongues, gold eyelets, laces/bows and outer leaf relief. Fixed tongue/laces occupy part of the mouth/eyelet space; selected all-part well paths are separate finite probes. No feet, body anchors, tying, gait, wearing, load or ordinary equipment/save.

audit.scope: One stationary matched EMPTY pair, two separately connected assemblies. Actual selected closed material/inner well/fixed lace/sole and finite studio-floor probes; no feet or body fixture.

audit.eyeletScope: Metal rings are closed toroidal material. Fixed laces occupy their intended openings and anchor into fixed cloth facing; no claim that every eyelet or all ankle-mouth space is unobstructed.
audit.limits: Finite selected rays, occupied chords, strict common-material witnesses and real triangle sole/floor pairs. These do not establish full-contact/stability/load/friction, continuous collision/curvature, physical tying, anatomy, wearing, gait or all-growth/ordinary-game equipment/save. Witnesses and extra reruns are not additional unique tests.
